title: Need for better generative model evaluation metrics
description: The paper states that advances in generative models that can sample but not estimate likelihood directly motivate further research into how to evaluate such models, highlighting the lack of suitable quantitative metrics.
canonical_description: generative models that can sample but not compute likelihood require better quantitative evaluation methods
